presentation_structure.title: Analytics in Action: From Data to Impact
presentation_structure.objective: Principais cases evidenciando problema de negócio, insight gerado e impacto para o cliente.

cases.business_problem: Aumentar transversalidade entre Cliente Banana, Cliente Maçã e Cliente Pera nos testes da Mesa de Performance: identificar cestas de SKUs estratégicos, clientes com maior propensão a cada cesta e produtos de alto valor que motivam a visita.
data_challenges: Apenas compras registradas, sem preferência declarada
Itens onipresentes de baixo valor (sacola, pão) dominavam o sinal
Mesmo produto com nomes diferentes entre BUs

steps: BM25 para ponderar relevância dos produtos
Matrix Factorization ALS para vetores de clientes e produtos
Similaridade de cosseno produto x produto (cestas) e cliente x cesta (público-alvo)

business_results.headline: +0.1875 relative conversion lift vs. second-best campaign (Destilados, record at Cliente Banana)

cases.executive_message: Collaborative filtering turned 24 months of purchases into 3 offer baskets, delivering +0.1875 relative conversion lift vs. the second-best campaign and R$ 218 incremental revenue in the Café basket.

cases.business_problem: Evoluir a recomendação de produtos para considerar, além de afinidade e conversão, o impacto esperado de cada recomendação no indicador de principalidade.

modules: Matrix Factorization (cross-sell e upsell em paralelo)
Camada de incremento de principalidade (ΔP) para repriorização

business_results.headline: +4 p.p. theoretical incremental principality gain vs. control (Top 3, backtest)
business_results.principality_points_top3: 3.336 pts with principality layer vs. 2.112 pts pure MF

cases.future_vision: Unified engine combining affinity, conversion, principality and profitability, extendable to PJ.
cases.executive_message: A productized engine combining look-alike segmentation, product affinity and principality impact showed +4 p.p. theoretical principality gain for associates who adopted Top 3 recommendations.

cases.case_name: Insight Agent | AI-powered Market Share & Share of Wallet Insights

business_problem.context: Produto automatizado de Market Share e Share of Wallet para adquirentes, em conformidade com a privacidade Mastercard.
business_problem.bottleneck: Geração de insights manual, limitando escala para os 30 adquirentes do pipeline.
business_problem.constraint: Dados restritos ao ambiente Mastercard, inviabilizando APIs externas de IA.

analytics_solution.innovation_1: Circuito multiagêntico com IA local em GPU: geradores -> julgadores -> corretores -> insights validados

innovation_2.description: Score de qualidade do insight com ML

cases.executive_message: A local multi-agent AI circuit generates, judges, corrects and validates insights at scale, enabling a 30-acquirer pipeline without growing the team and with zero data exposure.

presentation_design_guidance.section_2: Use revenue evolution (2023-2026F) as the dominant visual; use the Brazil 2023 milestone (+0.742857 relative YoY, +0.648649 relative vs. budget) as a callout and complement with a few scale proof points.
presentation_design_guidance.section_3: Use a capability map (not a project list), organized by client type (Emissores, Adquirentes, Merchants), linking each capability to a case.
presentation_design_guidance.section_4: One case card per case with Problem, Analytics, Impact and a single headline number.
presentation_design_guidance.section_5: Show progression: manual analysis -> advanced analytics -> productized engines -> AI-powered scalable assets.
